tara (marketing): quick one — were packaging the webinar bench slide deck and need a tiny reproducible artifact from eng/runtime.
We plan to call out per-variant p50/p90/p99 and provide exact artifacts so comms can independently verify. Target scope: 200 inferences per variant, include raw payloads, seeds, run CLI, and a 1-paragraph caveats note. Deadline: EOD Friday. @matt @sam

matt (eng-runtime): can do. couple clarifying Qs: which models/quantization and do you want warmup runs? also do you want token-level traces?

tara (marketing): models: gpt-7b-int8 and gpt-13b-fp16. Warmup: yes — we want cold (warmup=0) and warmed (warmup=25 tokens) for both. For 13B also run one with prefix-cache enabled. Token traces optional but helpful for engineering appendix.

sam (eng-ml): order of runs: 7B-int8 cold, 7B-int8 warm25, 13B-fp16 cold, 13B-fp16 warm25, 13B-fp16 warm25+prefix-cache. I'll provide the canonical prompt set and 200 deterministic seeds. We'll scrub any PII.

matt (eng-runtime): execution plan: run on staging-gpu-e cluster using a small reserved pool. Batching config: batching=auto-small. KV cache toggled with --cache-prefix true/false. We'll capture per-request server timestamps, request/response sizes, and per-token timing for warmed runs. Output package will include: samples.jsonl, seeds.txt, cli-commands.txt, run-notes.txt, traces/*.gz. ETA: Friday 14:00 PST.

tara (marketing): fantastic. Could you also drop a one-line suggested caption for the slide and a one-sentence suggested press blurb? Helps copywriting iterate quickly.

matt (eng-runtime): yes — will add two suggested lines: one short caption and one press sentence. Also Ill include a short notes file listing known bias: quantized cold p99 tail variance and how we recommend framing it (show warmed numbers as primary).

sam (eng-ml): small methodological note for the README: were using identical prompt set, same RNG seeds across variants, tokenization checked for parity, and no response filtering. Ill attach the prompt header and a 8-line public seed sample so the artifact remains small.

```
# reproduction example (simplified)
redwood-run --model gpt-7b-int8 --variant quantized --samples 200 --seed-file seeds.txt --warmup 25 --batching auto-small --cache-prefix false --out /artifacts/7b-int8-warm25
```

runtime-ci-bot: job queued: job-2026-2026123456-01 on staging-gpu-e. Will post results when done.

matt (eng-runtime): heads up: cold quantized runs show higher percentile jitter. Ill include a short analysis paragraph and recommended talking points: "Prefer warmed throughput for customer-facing claims; include coldstart callout in small font."

tara (marketing): perfect. If you can make the artifact friendly for non-technical reviewers (README with 3-step repro + where to click to open traces) thatd be ideal.

matt (eng-runtime): will do. final ETA: Friday 14:00 PST with artifact tarball and README. :thumbsup:

tara (marketing): thank you! prepping slide placeholders and marking them pending the artifact.

matt (eng-runtime): artifact uploaded at: https://internal-artifacts.redwood/benchpacks/2026123456/ (will be live when job completes).

sam (eng-ml): noted. Ill review the raw outputs for any tokenization drift and ping if anything odd pops up.

tara (marketing): great teamwork, thanks everyone.
